caption:
Me clearing my desk to start working

Me clearing my desk to start working.

Tidying feels like progress, which is why it works so well as a stall. Do two minutes of the real task first.

Send it to the friend whose desk is spotless before every deadline.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left. Four sheets of paper stand in a row on the right. One by one the figure looks at a sheet and it disappears, each time with a happy pulse, until the table is clear and it stands tall and proud. In the last seconds the text changes from: me clearing my desk to start working, to: desk: spotless. work: not started. Its eyes go wide and it trembles, then it narrows its eyes at the camera.
